messages:
ellen: heads-up — we got a spike in us-west control-plane errors (ingress 5xx). putting the 20:00 UTC release on hold until we confirm stability. :warning:
deploybot: automated note: release 'release/2026.03.21' status -> PAUSED by rule: incident-detect. canary jobs aborted: canary-42. scheduled requeue window cleared.
sam: copy. can you confirm which steps are blocked? do we need a rollback for the canary instances?
elllen: (typo) sorry — ellen: blocked are any new canaries and full rollout. canary instances already stopped; no full rollback yet, just hold. need quick decision on pinning the previous stable for tomorrow's window.
nora: +1 on pin. DB migration in that release is optional but risky — if we roll forward later we should ensure the migration is gated. recommend pin to v2026.03.14 across channels.
ops-oncall: we've restarted the control-plane replica, saw 10m of tailing errors then drop to normal. still seeing a few 503s to internal healthchecks. I want a 30m quiet period before we attempt any new canaries.
james: if we wait 30m we should also update release notes and comms so SRE oncall knows the change window shift. I can draft the update.
sam: action list: pin previous stable, hold release, update release notes, defer window and re-schedule deploybot. who will own pin?
nora: assign to me. I'll run the pin and add a comment to the changelog. command I'll use: ```rbctl pin release/2026.03.14 --reason "incident hold us-west"```
ellen: thanks. @deploybot can you propose the next available windows (UTC) based on current queue and weekday policy? prefer late-night window 02:00-04:00 UTC if possible.
deploybot: suggested requeue windows for team 'api': ["2026-03-22T02:00:00Z","2026-03-22T03:30:00Z","2026-03-23T02:00:00Z"]. auto-notes: maintain canary fraction 10% for first attempt, require healthcheck pass >= 99.5% over 15m.
ops-oncall: +1 to 02:00 target. I'll extend monitoring alerts to lower threshold for the next 2h and keep an eye on ingress tail.
james: I'll draft the release-notes blurb and ping legal/comms if we need customer-facing language. also tagging product in case they want a note in the dashboard.
sam: small checklist before we requeue: 1) pin done, 2) 30m quiet observed, 3) changelog updated, 4) ops ack, 5) deploybot scheduled. can we capture these as a quick triage record?
elllen: (typo) ellen: capturing now — creating a short incident thread in #incidents and will attach the deploybot schedule. anyone object to moving to 2026-03-22 02:00?
nora: pin complete and documented in the release ticket. comment: "pinned due to us-west control-plane incident; will re-evaluate before requeue."
ops-oncall: 30m quiet observed at +18m and stable at +33m. ready for requeue.
james: release notes updated and posted in the ticket. tagged @product.
sam: ok moving forward — @deploybot please requeue to the first suggested 02:00 slot and keep the canary fraction at 10% with auto-fallback to pinned version on any regression.
deploybot: acknowledged. requeue scheduled: 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. canary policy set: fraction=0.10, health_window=15m, rollback_on=regression. notification will be sent to #eng-releases 30m before slot.
elllen: (typo) ellen: thanks everyone. I'll write a short follow-up in #incidents with timeline + notes for postmortem. we should plan a brief retro tomorrow to consider better pre-flight checks for control-plane pressure. :thumbsup:
sam: thanks — closing this thread once the deploybot confirms the schedule message posts.
deploybot: scheduled notification posted to #eng-releases at 2026-03-22T01:30:00Z (will include canary PID and rollback hooks).
